conceptBlocks.text: 什么是环比、同比与趋势？
环比比较上一自然月，同比比较去年同月。

items: 两者均为（本期−基期）÷基期×100%。

conceptBlocks.text: 仅有连续月份和每店每月唯一记录时，窗口偏移1与12才分别对应上月和去年同月。

syntax.purpose: 销售趋势、同比与环比的语法模板如下，各部分含义见下方说明。

problem: 经营主管需要2025年逐月线下净销售趋势，读取2023—2025年的完整历史轴。无交易且确认数据完整的月份按零处理；缺报不能补零。

methodBlocks.text: m 从日历取去重月份，a 按门店与年月汇总，b 交叉连接主档和月份后左接销售。p 在同店分区计算两种偏移；
q 按上期为正且本期更低标记下滑，z 用最近三行求和，三个标记都为1才算连续下滑。最终才筛2025，否则一月失去十二月和去年一月。
小型示例使用递归表达式生成2024—2025月份，仅用于独立复验。

breakdown.title: 建立连续月份轴
breakdown.sql:
WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE day<='2025-12-31')
SELECT * FROM m ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 3;
breakdown.purpose: 先建立到 2025 年底为止的连续月份轴 m。
breakdown.reason: 月份轴来自日期维度表，没有交易的月份也会出现在这里，才能分清“没有销售”和“没有这个月”。

breakdown.title: 汇总门店月净销售
breakdown.sql:
WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE day<='2025-12-31'), a AS (SELECT store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' GROUP BY store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7))
SELECT * FROM a ORDER BY 1, 2, 3 LIMIT 3;
breakdown.purpose: 按门店和月份汇总线下净销售 net。
breakdown.reason: 这一步只包含有交易的月份，没有交易的月份此时还不存在。

breakdown.title: 补齐门店月份
breakdown.sql:
WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE day<='2025-12-31'), a AS (SELECT store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' GROUP BY store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), b AS (SELECT s.store_id,m.month_key,COALESCE(a.net,0) net FROM stores s CROSS JOIN m LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id AND a.m=m.month_key)
SELECT * FROM b ORDER BY 1, 2, 3 LIMIT 3;
breakdown.purpose: 把门店和月份轴配成完整的组合，没有交易的月份净销售补成 0。
breakdown.reason: 先补齐再做窗口计算，LAG 取到的才是真正的上个月；确认数据完整后，才允许把无交易视作 0。

breakdown.title: 取上月与上年同月基线
breakdown.sql:
WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE day<='2025-12-31'), a AS (SELECT store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' GROUP BY store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), b AS (SELECT s.store_id,m.month_key,COALESCE(a.net,0) net FROM stores s CROSS JOIN m LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id AND a.m=m.month_key), p AS (SELECT *,LAG(net) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prev,LAG(net,12) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prior_year FROM b)
SELECT * FROM p ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 LIMIT 3;
breakdown.purpose: 用窗口函数给每个门店月份取上个月 prev 和去年同月 prior_year 的净销售。
breakdown.reason: 月份连续时，向前取 1 行是上个月，向前取 12 行是去年同月。

breakdown.title: 标记负环比
breakdown.sql:
WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE day<='2025-12-31'), a AS (SELECT store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' GROUP BY store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), b AS (SELECT s.store_id,m.month_key,COALESCE(a.net,0) net FROM stores s CROSS JOIN m LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id AND a.m=m.month_key), p AS (SELECT *,LAG(net) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prev,LAG(net,12) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prior_year FROM b), q AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN prev>0 AND net<prev THEN 1 ELSE 0 END falling FROM p)
SELECT * FROM q ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 LIMIT 3;
breakdown.purpose: 标记本月比上个月下降的月份 falling。
breakdown.reason: 下降的判断要用到上一步的 prev，所以放在后面。

breakdown.title: 滚动累计最近三月下滑次数
breakdown.sql:
WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE day<='2025-12-31'), a AS (SELECT store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' GROUP BY store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), b AS (SELECT s.store_id,m.month_key,COALESCE(a.net,0) net FROM stores s CROSS JOIN m LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id AND a.m=m.month_key), p AS (SELECT *,LAG(net) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prev,LAG(net,12) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prior_year FROM b), q AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN prev>0 AND net<prev THEN 1 ELSE 0 END falling FROM p), z AS (SELECT *,SUM(falling) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) fall3 FROM q)
SELECT * FROM z ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 LIMIT 3;
breakdown.purpose: 累计最近三个月（当前月和前两个月）的下降次数 fall3。
breakdown.reason: 窗口范围取当前行和前两行，共三个月。

breakdown.title: 计算环比、同比与连续下滑标记
breakdown.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE day<='2025-12-31'), a AS (SELECT store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' GROUP BY store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), b AS (SELECT s.store_id,m.month_key,COALESCE(a.net,0) net FROM stores s CROSS JOIN m LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id AND a.m=m.month_key), p AS (SELECT *,LAG(net) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prev,LAG(net,12) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prior_year FROM b), q AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN prev>0 AND net<prev THEN 1 ELSE 0 END falling FROM p), z AS (SELECT *,SUM(falling) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) fall3 FROM q) SELECT store_id,month_key,net net_cents,ROUND(100.0*(net-prev)/NULLIF(prev,0),2) mom_pct,ROUND(100.0*(net-prior_year)/NULLIF(prior_year,0),2) yoy_pct,CASE WHEN fall3=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END three_declines FROM z WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' ORDER BY net_cents DESC
breakdown.purpose: 最后计算环比、同比百分比，并在连续三个月下降时标记 three_declines，只保留 2025 年各月。
breakdown.reason: 必须先在包含更早历史的完整月份轴上计算窗口，最后再筛 2025 年，否则 1 月的上期和去年同月都会丢失。

resultBlocks.text: 一月100对上月120，环比−16.67%，对去年一月80同比25%；二月环比−10%；三月环比−33.33%，连续三次下滑；四月无交易净额0，环比−100%；
五月基期为零，环比未定义。原企业预览一月环比−50.64%、同比31.32%，说明短期与年度表现可以方向不同。

extensions.label: 小型示例：连续月份骨架
extensions.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE months(month_key) AS (SELECT '2024-01' UNION ALL SELECT strftime('%Y-%m',date(month_key||'-01','+1 month')) FROM months WHERE month_key<'2025-12'),
stores AS (SELECT 1 AS store_id),
sales AS (SELECT '2024-01' AS month_key,80 AS net UNION ALL SELECT '2024-12',120 UNION ALL SELECT '2025-01',100 UNION ALL SELECT '2025-02',90 UNION ALL SELECT '2025-03',60 UNION ALL SELECT '2025-05',50),
b AS (SELECT s.store_id,m.month_key,COALESCE(a.net,0) net FROM stores s CROSS JOIN months m LEFT JOIN sales a ON a.month_key=m.month_key),
p AS (SELECT *,LAG(net) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prev,LAG(net,12) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prior_year FROM b),
q AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN prev>0 AND net<prev THEN 1 ELSE 0 END falling FROM p),
z AS (SELECT *,SUM(falling) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) fall3 FROM q) SELECT month_key,net FROM b WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-05' ORDER BY month_key;

comparison.text: 环比不是同比；相邻数据行不是天然相邻月份。

example.text: 先筛2025再算窗口，或删除零销售月份。

reason.text: 先筛 2025 年再开窗口时，1 月没有上个月、去年同月的数据，环比和同比会变成 NULL；删除零销售的月份会让 LAG 把更早的月份当作“上个月”，环比就错位了。

correction.text: 先构建完整历史轴并计算窗口，然后筛报告期。
